title: Houdini handoff
intro: A manifest from the planner to the one bridge owner who talks to Houdini: five lanes in the order the asset goes through them, then the manifest itself. Every card starts blank; the board never calls Houdini.

steps.guide: The asset this handoff is about. A result node of this project (a mesh Timmy measured, a VoxVision record) lands here from Nodes; else name its file in the manifest below.
The values the import needs. This project's parameter node lands here from Nodes; its Save and Rebuild go through the live board. Nothing on this board runs by itself.

No native Houdini operation is configured in Studio. A workflow node whose block runs the cook lands here from Nodes, and its Run goes through the live board; until then the manifest is what the bridge owner takes.

text: How the source enters Houdini: the node that takes it, in the project's units.
The scale and pivot the asset must have before anything else reads it.
How the geometry is packed before a material binds to it.
Where materials live and when they are assigned.
How many variations each hero asset gets, and how they differ.
HANDOFF MANIFEST · one per asset, filled by the planner

data.fields: asset id, source, scale, family, expected node, import method, pack order, qa status, bridge owner

text: This board writes the manifest. It never calls Houdini, loads or saves a scene: the bridge owner imports from the manifest.
